question: To minimise core losses in transformer, __________ material is used for core lamination.
solution:
The correct answer is __CRGO silicon steel sheet__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• CRGO silicon steel sheet__ is used to minimise core losses in transformers.
 
• CRGO stands for Cold Rolled Grain Oriented silicon steel.
 
• The sheets are specially processed to have high magnetic permeability and low core loss.
 
• It helps in reducing eddy current loss and hysteresis loss in the transformer core.
 
• The grain orientation of CRGO steel ensures maximum efficiency in magnetic flux transfer.
 
• CRGO steel is widely used in electrical transformers due to its superior properties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Transformer Core Material:**
 
 
• The transformer core is usually made up of laminated sheets to reduce eddy current losses.
 
• Silicon steel is commonly used due to its high electrical resistivity.
 
 
 
• **Core Losses:**
 
 
• Core losses consist of eddy current loss and hysteresis loss.
 
• These losses occur in the transformer core when it is subjected to alternating magnetic fields.
